t: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, all provisions of law applicable to a male officer in the Judge Advocate General’s Corps of the Navy, including the Naval Reserve, are applicable to a woman officer in that corps.

fable.w: This section only extends the laws that apply to male officers in the Navy Judge Advocate General's Corps to women officers in that corps. There is no tempting reading here: it provides for no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue involving anyone outside the federal government. It is a rule about the internal legal status of military personnel.

qwen_block.w: This section establishes equal legal status for female officers in the Navy's Judge Advocate General's Corps relative to male officers. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or decision-making process involving parties outside the federal government. The actors involved are federal military officers and the laws governing them.
qwen_block.s: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, all provisions of law applicable to a male officer in the Judge Advocate General’s Corps of the Navy, including the Naval Reserve, are applicable to a woman officer in that corps.
